svg.title: Ehricke (the industrial rotor): band plan
svg.desc: The industrial rotor unrolled into its three gravity bands, outer band on top. Each strip is drawn at its own radius, so the strips are 12.1 km, 7.9 km and 3.6 km wide. Along the vertical axis the momentum bay is at the bottom (x 2,750 m) and the shipyard side at the top (x 6,250 m). Drawn on the strips: seven rim rings, four spoke stations with eight arms each, 24 axial girders on the outer strip, eight sectors, cargo rails, busways and the 21 occupied equipment slots coloured by contents. The left and right edges are the same line. 1 viewBox unit is 1 m.

g.text: Rim ring at a spoke station (7 rings)
Spoke arm (8 per spoke station, 4 stations)
Three gravity bands unrolled, each at its own radius. Angle 0 is at the left edge and the left and right edges are the same line. Rotor centre at station x = 4,500 m.
